answer: Each identity keeps a kernel of standing earned only by doing real work for others, recorded as timber receipts: each epoch it must deliver one small verifiable task to a stranger, who signs a receipt chained to the identity key. Standing ripples outward only through signed receipts, never by self-claim. A farm of a thousand fakes needs a thousand strangers served and a thousand receipts earned, each costing real hours of work that cannot be copied, parallelized, or bought, because a receipt without the work is worthless.
